page.overview:
Who is Armoured Ofnir Dragon?

An Armoured Ofnir Dragon is an armoured version of the Ofnir Dragon from the Vikings theme. As the name suggests, it has greater defense then the original. It flies at a tremendous speed and is one of the toughest enemies the Vikings have fought.
